title: Resilience Lens: contextualized root-cause index for timeouts, overload & model responses
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Operators need a single-pane view that turns raw trace hooks and metric streams into human-friendly, contextualized reasons for inference failures. Current dashboards show raw error counts and scattered traces; they don’t group related signatures (e.g. client cancellations that look like timeouts, model rejections vs. model runtime exceptions, overload vs. network backlog) nor surface the most actionable dimensions (route, model_version, seq_len_bucket, queue_time).

Goal: Build a "Resilience Lens" that: (1) enriches incoming traces with a normalized failure_reason enum, (2) emits new metrics and histogram buckets used by dashboards and alerts, and (3) provides a Grafana dashboard and alert playbook that surfaces the top operational causes and a ranked list of rollback/mitigation actions.

Scope:
- Trace-hook changes to tag spans with failure_reason and failure_signature (string) at service boundary points (proxy, runtime, model).
- Metric/log pipeline mappings to convert failure_reason into prometheus labels and to synthesize failure_signature counters/histograms.
- Dashboard: a ranked heatmap (route x failure_reason), time-series breakdown, top-20 failure_signature table with example trace links, and drift indicators vs. baseline.
- Alerts & runbook: SLO-aligned alerts for sustained increases in failure_rate and correlated latency spikes; automatic routing guidance (model fallback, increase capacity, client retry guidance).

Out of scope for this ticket: automated remediation, long-term ML-driven root-cause clustering (future work).
acceptance_criteria:
- Tracehook consistently sets failure_reason in >=95% of terminal spans for failed requests.
- Prometheus metrics exported: inference_failure_total{failure_reason}, inference_failure_signature_count, inference_latency_bucketed by seq_len_bucket and queue_time_ms_bucket.
- Grafana dashboard deployed to production Grafana org with panels: heatmap (route vs failure_reason), timeseries with SLO overlays, top-20 signatures table with sample trace links, and a correlation panel for cache_hit_rate vs failure_rate.
- Alerting rules in alertmanager: P0 if failure_rate > 0.5% for any production route for 10m AND median latency increased by >30% vs baseline. Runbook link included in alert annotations.
- Load test: synthetic traffic (see test plan) shows no more than 5% additional CPU/ingest cost for tracehook enrichments at 2x baseline traffic.
implementation_notes:
Design decisions: use a small, finite failure_reason enum to avoid high-cardinality labels (timeout, overload, model_error, client_abort, http_4xx, http_5xx, grpc_code, policy_denied). failure_signature will be a short hashed string (6 chars) + human-readable suffix to keep cardinality reasonable.

Tracehook changes: add instrumentation at proxy ingress, runtime deadline checks, model-executor exception handler, and response-path annotator. Each hook emits: failure_reason, failure_signature, model_variant, seq_len_bucket, queue_time_ms. Use existing tracehook lib (tracing/hookv2) and extend schema v2.

Metrics pipeline: update log->metric mapping in the telemetry ingest lambda to map failure_reason -> prometheus label, aggregate failure_signature counts with a daily TTL to avoid unbounded series. Add histogram buckets for queue_time_ms in [0,10,50,100,250,500,1000,2500].

Dashboard spec: implement panels using Loki for sample traces and Prometheus for metrics. Provide links from top signatures to curated trace samples (sample rate 1:1000 for normal traffic, raise to 1:50 on anomalies).

Rollout plan: feature-flag trace enrichments per cluster; start with canary (staging), then one production region, monitor cost and downstream ingestion. Gradual rollout over 2 weeks.

Instrumentation PR: github.com/redwood-inference/tracehook/pull/2143
Telemetry mapping PR: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/1015
Dashboard PR: github.com/redwood-inference/grafana-dashboards/pull/287
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for tracehook enrichers and failure_reason derivation logic.
- Integration: run synthetic scenarios that generate: client cancels, model runtime exceptions, simulated GPU OOM, proxy overload (backpressure), HTTP 5xx and gRPC code variants. Verify metrics & traces.
- Load test: replay 2x production qps with trace enrichment enabled; assert ingestion cost delta and metric cardinality within bounds.
- Safety: feature-flag toggles allow immediate shutoff if downstream ingestion cost or high-cardinality issues appear.
runbook_and_alerts:
- Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Resilience+Lens+Runbook
- Pager: On P0 alert, primary oncall investigates panel: heatmap route x failure_reason, top signatures, sample traces. Follow decision tree: check model_variant error rates -> check queue_time_ms and GPU util -> verify proxy error rates. Suggested mitigations annotated per signature (scale up, model-fallback, cache-prime, client-retry).
